purpose: Allowlisted evaluator actions. A scenario step is invalid unless its action appears here.

reference_resolution.fixture: A dot path into the case fixture object.
reference_resolution.fixture_file: A repository-relative JSON fixture path, fingerprinted before execution.
reference_resolution.suffix_ref: Keys ending in _ref resolve a dot path against the fixture, run context, or a prior step observation.
reference_resolution.run_context: Principal, group, source, model, and trace values may only be injected from the frozen run context, never guessed.

availability_semantics.existing_surface: VERA already exposes the capability. If the declared surface is absent or behaves incorrectly, record FAIL.
availability_semantics.harness_required: The capability exists below a public boundary or needs deterministic orchestration. If the evaluation harness is unavailable, record BLOCKED and name the missing adapter.
availability_semantics.external_runner_required: The capability belongs to the consuming agent or load environment, not VERA. Missing runner means NOT_APPLICABLE only when the assertion activation allows it; otherwise BLOCKED.
availability_semantics.product_capability_missing: The scenario intentionally probes a known product gap. Absence is an observed FAIL, never BLOCKED.

observation_path.syntax: dot path rooted at the case observation envelope; zero-based array indexes use [n]
observation_path.reference_value: Use an expected object of the form {"observation_ref": "path.to.value"}; strings are always literals.

operators.eq: Observed value deep-equals expected value or the value at expected.observation_ref.
operators.neq: Observed value does not deep-equal expected value or referenced observation.
operators.contains: Observed string contains expected string case-insensitively; collections and mappings recursively apply contains to their items and values.
operators.exists: Target resolves and is not null. Expected must be true.
operators.absent: Target does not resolve or resolves to null. Expected must be true.
operators.gte: Observed numeric value is greater than or equal to expected numeric value.
operators.lte: Observed numeric value is less than or equal to expected numeric value.
operators.lt: Observed numeric value is less than expected numeric value.
operators.gt: Observed numeric value is greater than expected numeric value.
operators.all: Every expected item is present in the observed collection.
operators.none: No expected item is present in the observed collection.
operators.unchanged: Canonical before and after snapshots are deep-equal; expected must be true.
operators.equivalent: Domain-normalized values are semantically equal under the named comparison adapter; expected must be true.
